comment_cards.surface_request: Provide a more transparent account of the split construction, add robustness checks under at least one temporally held-out split, and clarify whether the reported gains remain when near-duplicate review-response pairs are removed.

It is also unclear whether papers from the same journal issue, topic cluster, or review round can appear across different splits.
